notes.title: Update 1.2.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes: [p]A small patch for Kudamono Drop has just been released! Here are the patch notes for this version.[/p][p][/p][p]- In Endless Mode and Banana Bonanza, your currently selected power-up will now recharge for another use every 60 seconds after it has been used.[/p][p]- Made some speed adjustments to Endless Mode (No Gimmicks) and Banana Bonanza.[/p][p]- Avocado Companion seeds now grow over distance traveled and have a larger hit-box.[/p][p]- Fixed supernovas not appearing in the background during Endless Mode.[/p][p]- Fixed item activate sound still playing even if sound effects are turned off.[/p][p]- Fixed supernova sound still playing even if sound effects are turned off.[/p][p]- Fixed Avocado Companion seeds still firing if the player has lost the level.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your continued support.[/p]

notes.title: 1 Year Anniversary & Update 2 Launch
notes.notes:
[p]It has been one year since Kudamono Drop released, and to celebrate, update 2 is finally here![/p][p][/p][p][b]Here is the changelog for the Update 2 version![/b]
- Added 4 new basket colors[/p][p]- Added 4 new accessories: bananas, ribbon, heart eyes, cat ears[/p][p]- Added 20 new pattern colors[/p][p]- Added new boss music to level 50, composed by Koruru[/p][p]- Added a new item which unlocks automatically after defeating Avocado-san for the first time[/p][p]- Added a new Banana Bonanza timer upgrade, which can grant up to 30 extra seconds in Banana Bonanza[/p][p]- Added an afterimage effect when teleporting the basket by tapping anywhere on the screen[/p][p]- Fixed keyboard/controller menu cursor appearing during mouse movement[/p][p]- Fixed equip button text changing from Japanese to English when Japanese is the language currently selected[/p][p]- Added an animation for the keyboard/controller menu cursor[/p][p]- Added an animation when losing a heart[/p][p]- Added star explosions to the background during levels[/p][p]- You can now re-pause the game during the countdown after un-pausing[/p][p]- Level 50 and level 96-100's icons has been adjusted to make it more clear they're special levels[/p][p]- Fixed missing outline on flower crown accessory[/p][p]- Fixed basket accessories overlapping Avocado-san[/p][p]- Decreased price of white and black baskets from 250 coins to 100 coins[/p][p]- Added clarification text for Endless Mode's double coins[/p][p]
Let's keep catching fruit for many years to come![/p]

notes.title: Steam Cloud Saves now available!
notes.notes: [p]Steam Cloud Saves are now available! Take your save games across your PCs and even your Steam Deck![/p]

notes.title: New Update Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing Kudamono Drop! A new update is now under production!

After defeating Avocado-san on level 50, he will now help you on your journey in the form of a new item you can equip! Two avocados will appear by your side and shoot seeds for a limited time, which will collect any fruit the seeds collide with, even large ones! This new update will also include 20 new pattern colors, Banana Bonanza timer upgrades, quality of life fixes, new visual upgrades, and more! Stay tuned for the release date.

Check out the teaser trailer below! Thank you for the continued support of Kudamono Drop.
